review:
Great Game Serengeti is the savanna follow-up to Great Game Rockies and uses the same Hunt mechanic. A Hunting Season symbol fires five shots at targets above the reels; one- to three-star animals on hit reels become coins, while four-star animals become traps worth at least 10x that collect every other coin and trap. Wilds on hit reels can multiply one to five of them by up to 20x.

Stampede Reveals can start before a spin lands, always bringing a Hunting Season symbol and no low-paying symbols. Three FS give 8 free spins, four give 10 with a Lion Bar that awards Stampede Reveals, and five unlock the hidden Epic bonus. Hacksaw lists 3/5 volatility, a 5,000x max win and RTPs from 96.29% to 86.24%.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.24% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
